pass_rule: At least one controlled factual correction cycle tested end-to-end with source submission, reviewer decision, version history and score impact where applicable.
blockers_to_start: no authorised real controlled correction case has been selected
no real reviewer decision/version history has been completed end-to-end
no real score-impact correction rehearsal exists
public CPR log must remain free of fabricated synthetic entries
human_gate: Only authorised human review may accept/reject a real correction and create a real CPR entry.
